title: synthyris pinnatifida var. lanuginosa
intro: Synthyris pinnatifida var. lanuginosa, commonly known as the hairy synthyris, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae) that is native to North America. The hairy synthyris has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm irritated tissues, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. Bioactive constituents of the hairy synthyris include triterpenoid saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
